answer: The haven graph is rebuilt each epoch, so that the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the trellis audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 3 times its size, so a group of 87 keys loses far more than 87 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the beacon checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
